intent: Read links instead of AI Overviews
title: Use Google's Web results
steps: Run your search on Google.
Select the Web filter among the result tabs. If it is tucked away, open More and choose Web.
Browse the resulting text links.
caveat: This is a per-search view, not a permanent AI Overview off switch. Other Google surfaces may still show AI features.

intent: Search without generated answers or images
title: Use DuckDuckGo without AI
steps: Open noai.duckduckgo.com.
Search as usual, or bookmark it for next time.
caveat: DuckDuckGo says this destination turns off its AI features and filters AI-generated images by default. A filter cannot guarantee every synthetic image is caught.

intent: Stop AI answers in DuckDuckGo
title: Set Search Assist to never
steps: Open DuckDuckGo Search Settings, or the gear on a Search Assist answer.
Set Search Assist frequency to Never.
If desired, use the AI Features settings to hide Duck.ai separately.
caveat: Search Assist and Duck.ai have separate controls. The menu can differ in the browser app.

intent: Keep Kagi search free of answer prompts
title: Switch off Kagi AI access
steps: Open Kagi Settings, then Search AI Settings.
Turn off AI Feature Access.
Turn off Auto Quick Answer as well if you have used it.
caveat: Kagi says normal searches do not use generative AI unless invoked. This hides Search AI triggers, but does not hide links to separate Kagi products. Kagi requires an account and paid search plan for regular use.

intent: See fewer Shorts on YouTube
title: Ask YouTube for fewer Shorts
steps: On Home, find a Shorts grid.
Open its More menu and choose Show fewer Shorts.
caveat: This is feedback on recommendations, not a complete Shorts disable switch.

intent: Remove personalized Home recommendations
title: Clear and pause YouTube watch history
steps: Open YouTube History in My Activity.
Delete existing watch history.
Turn off watch history in the Controls tab.
caveat: When little relevant history remains, YouTube says Home recommendations are removed. Your viewing history and resume behavior also change; this affects recommendations, not all AI or all suggested content.

intent: Stop posts from communities you did not join
title: Disable Reddit Home recommendations
steps: On reddit.com, open Preferences and turn off Show recommendations in home feed.
In the mobile app, open Account settings, then Personalized Recommendations, and turn off Enable home feed recommendations.
caveat: This controls Home recommendations. Ranking of posts from joined communities and other Reddit discovery areas remain separate.

intent: Read Reddit posts instead of AI answers
title: Use Reddit's post search
steps: Enter a query in Reddit Search.
Choose Posts or Communities in results instead of the Ask action.
caveat: Reddit's Ask action invokes AI-powered search. The ordinary search interface and available tabs may vary by platform.

intent: See only accounts you follow
title: Open Instagram's Following feed
steps: From Instagram's home screen, open the feed selector near the Instagram title.
Choose Following to see posts from accounts you follow, with newer posts first.
caveat: This changes the feed you are viewing, not a global default or a verified AI-content filter. Accounts you follow may still post synthetic content.

intent: See recent posts from people and pages
title: Use Facebook Feeds
steps: Open the Feeds tab from Facebook's navigation or menu.
Select Friends, Favorites, Pages, or Groups when useful.
caveat: Feeds shows recent posts from followed sources. It does not authenticate whether a post was human-made, and ads or other interface elements may remain.

intent: See fewer generated Pins
title: Tune Pinterest's AI content
steps: Open Pinterest Settings or Refine your recommendations.
Choose the AI content tab and adjust the categories you want to see less of.
Hide individual unwanted Pins to refine the feed further.
caveat: This reduces selected AI content in recommendations; it is not a blanket exclusion or reliable provenance test.

intent: Filter synthetic image search results
title: Use Kagi's AI image filter
steps: Open Kagi Image Search settings and enable the AI image filter.
Use the shield on a result to lower or block a site that slips through.
caveat: Image detection can miss or misclassify content. Kagi's account and plan requirements apply.

intent: Reduce AI summaries and writing prompts in Gmail
title: Turn off Workspace smart features
steps: Open Gmail Settings and find Smart features.
Open Manage Workspace smart features and turn off Smart features in Google Workspace.
Review the separate Gmail, Chat and Meet smart features control if you also want to remove Smart Compose and related features.
caveat: This turns off more than AI summaries. It can remove other useful Workspace features, and account or organization controls may differ.

intent: Write in Word without Copilot
title: Disable Copilot in Word
steps: Open Word's Copilot settings.
Clear the Enable Copilot checkbox.
Repeat in other Microsoft 365 apps if you also use them.
caveat: This setting is per app and device. Availability depends on subscription, version, and account type; organization administrators may control work accounts.

intent: Stop system writing assistance on iPhone
title: Turn off Apple Intelligence
steps: Open Settings on iPhone or iPad, or System Settings on Mac.
Open Apple Intelligence & Siri and turn off Apple Intelligence.
caveat: This disables the broader Apple Intelligence feature set, not only Writing Tools. It only appears on supported devices and software.

intent: Keep Firefox's AI enhancements out of view
title: Block Firefox AI enhancements
platform: Firefox desktop 148+, Firefox iOS where available
steps: Open Firefox Settings and choose AI Controls.
Turn on Block AI enhancements.
caveat: Mozilla documents this for desktop Firefox 148 and later; mobile availability and rollout can differ. Websites can still display their own AI content.

intent: Stop Edge Copilot reading page context
title: Disable Edge context clues
steps: Open Edge's More menu, then Copilot and AI.
Turn off Allow Copilot to read context clues on the web.
caveat: This changes Copilot's page-context access, not the presence of every Copilot entry point or AI feature in Edge.

intent: Stop your Grok interactions being used for training
title: Opt out of Grok training
steps: Open X Settings and privacy, then Privacy and safety.
Find Grok and data sharing controls and turn off the model training option.
caveat: This is a data-use control, not a way to hide Grok or AI-made posts. Public posts and separate privacy settings have different implications.

intent: Shop on Amazon without asking its AI assistant
title: Use standard product search
steps: Type a product or brand into Amazon's usual search field.
Browse product listings and filters directly rather than opening Alexa for Shopping's assistant button.
Read the seller, product details, and original reviews before deciding.
caveat: Amazon renamed Rufus to Alexa for Shopping in May 2026. This route avoids invoking the assistant; it does not disable its entry points, ranking, or generated material elsewhere.

intent: Check whether an Etsy item used AI
title: Read the seller's making details
steps: Open the item's full description and seller information.
Look for a disclosure of seller-prompted AI creation and how the item was made.
Ask the seller for clarification when process or provenance matters to you.
caveat: Etsy requires disclosure for seller-prompted AI creations, but a listing's wording is not independent verification. Etsy allows some AI-assisted items; this is a checking route, not an AI-free filter.
